propositions: COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE instructs FAIL callers that ticket comments will be considered on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence.
Untagged external criteria are deliberately classified as codebase-verifiable per ADR 0043, so ticket-comment-only evidence cannot satisfy them regardless of retry.
The remediation guidance creates a contract mismatch with completion_verifier.md and ADR 0043 by directing operators to futile retry paths for untagged external evidence.
The strengthened interface test requires the exact [operator-attested] tag, repository/external distinction, and the untagged external limitation statement in remediation output.

Current production completion pipeline correctly accepts operator-attested evidence when the exact tag is present and correctly rejects untagged external evidence, confirming the tag prerequisite is enforced.
